review_notes: Inspected all 151 lines. Definitions: TracialState.comap, scalarMatrixHom, singleMatrix, plus TracialState.ext and the trace-correspondence theorems. Checked the project's TracialState structure (OAI/Analysis/Pureness/Traces/TracialStates.lean) and diagonalMatrixHom (MatrixDiagonal.lean, built from Matrix.diagonalAlgHom via CStarMatrix.ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv). Mathlib has no tracial-state concept, so TracialState.comap and TracialState.ext extend a project-specific structure rather than competing with Mathlib. The positivity proof in comap could use PositiveLinearMap.comp/ofClass with StarRingHomClass.instOrderHomClass, but that is proof shortening, which the rubric excludes. scalarMatrixHom is a star-algebra-hom upgrade of Matrix.scalar (Mathlib's is only `α →+* Matrix n n α` on plain Matrix) for the CStarMatrix type synonym. Mathlib has no star-alg-hom or CStarMatrix version, so this is a useful bundled specialisation. singleMatrix is Matrix.single transported to CStarMatrix, whose multiplication is defined separately; Mathlib has no CStarMatrix single. The transported lemmas reuse Matrix.single_mul_single_same, single_mul_single_of_ne, matrix_eq_sum_single and sum_single_eq_diagonal through ofMatrixStarAlgEquiv rather than re-proving them. I judged this a necessary bridge, not a competing concept. Outside this rubric's Mathlib scope: near-identical copies of scalarMatrixHom, singleMatrix, TracialState.comap/ext and matrixTracialState_comap exist in OAI/Analysis/JiangSu/MatrixAlgebras/CornerCompression.lean and JiangSu/Model.lean. That is a within-project consolidation opportunity, not Mathlib duplication, so it is not reported. Remaining uncertainty: whether the transported singleMatrix lemmas should count as a conversion cost. Abstained because Mathlib provides no CStarMatrix-level alternative.
